title: Import library
rescanMessage: The current list is cleared — unimported review work (confirms, skips, manual matches) is discarded.
importMessage: Comic folders stay where they are and become series in your collection; plugin-handled items (e.g. book files) are filed into their own library.
scanTitle: Find series added since the last scan — keeps your review work
rescanButtonTitle: Clear the list and rescan everything (discards unimported review work)
intro: Scan your root folders for series not yet in the collection. Each is matched against the metadata source — confirm or fix the matches, then import. Files stay where they are.
noCandidates: No candidates yet. Click “Scan for new” to find series to import.
importsWithFileInfo: imports with the file's own info
